name: HSBC Holdings
title: HSBC Holdings plc 1Q 2026 Presentation to Investors and Analysts - Transcript

read.thesis: Strong Q1 with ROTE 18.7% and Banking NII guidance raised to around $46bn, but ECL guidance lifted to 45bp and a $0.4bn UK fraud charge plus $0.3bn Middle East reserve weigh on credit; no supply-side capex signal for a bank.

triggers.label: Banking NII raised to ~$46bn
triggers.quote: We are now upgrading our full-year Banking NII guidance to around $46 billion.

triggers.label: ECL charge guidance 45bp
triggers.quote: we are updating our full-year 2026 credit guidance to around 45 basis points.

triggers.label: Wealth Fee income +15% to $2.7bn
triggers.quote: we grew Fee and other income by 15% to $2.7 billion.

guidance.quote: We are now upgrading our full-year Banking NII guidance to around $46 billion.
we are updating our full-year 2026 credit guidance to around 45 basis points.
We are on track to achieve our target of 1% cost growth in 2026 compared to 2025 on a target basis.
Return on tangible equity of 17% or better, excluding notable items, each year.
We continue to target a dividend payout ratio for 2026 of 50% of earnings per ordinary share

red_flags.label: UK secondary securitisation fraud charge $0.4bn
red_flags.quote: We also include $0.4 billion for fraud-related secondary securitisation exposure with a financial sponsor in the UK.

red_flags.label: Private credit exposure $22bn
red_flags.quote: at $22 billion, both drawn and undrawn private credit and related exposure

evasions.quote: the synergies at the moment have been very little, if any, because it's just the start of the process.
a share buyback decision is done on a quarterly basis.
